task: Match LTX final-video fidelity to latest Wan restore-fast beta 0.1, 1.0, 2.0; prioritize measured speed among quality-matched candidates.

common_metrics.resize: torch area; applied identically to each model and its own native reference
common_metrics.comparisons: within each model against native; never compare Wan pixels to LTX pixels

selection.choose: lowest summed LTX generation time among qualifying measured thresholds; preserve the full sweep including regressions
selection.refinement: add thresholds around quality feasibility boundaries if the initial grid is insufficient
selection.cross_model_equivalence: operational metric match with joint-video inspection; not a claim of identical perceptual quality

validation: Freeze thresholds on six calibration cases, then evaluate four new prompts on both models without using them in initial threshold selection.
reuse: Archived LTX beta 2.0 / 2.6 videos and native references can be reused for offline calibration only. Fresh native runs for held-out final timing.
report_media: Combined videos only; no screenshots or poster images.

calibration_cases.prompt: A black and white border collie running at an easy pace along a sandy beach near the water. Small waves roll onto the sand as the camera tracks smoothly beside the dog. A single uninterrupted photographic shot with stable framing, consistent natural illumination, clear subject details, coherent movement and realistic textures. No cuts or abrupt camera motion.

A woman in a green sweater turns a pottery bowl slowly on a wheel in a softly lit studio. Her hands guide the wet clay with careful continuous movements. A single uninterrupted photographic shot with stable framing, consistent natural illumination, clear subject details, coherent movement and realistic textures. No cuts or abrupt camera motion.

A woman wearing a cream sweater folds a red scarf on a wooden table beside a bright window. Her hands move slowly and continuously, and soft fabric wrinkles follow the motion. A steady medium close-up with realistic detail and consistent sunlight.

A gray pony walks along a narrow dirt path beside a field of yellow wildflowers. Its mane and tail move softly in a breeze while the camera tracks gently from the side. Continuous realistic shot with natural gait and stable proportions.

A little green rowboat drifts beneath a stone arch bridge on a quiet canal. Reflections of the bridge ripple across the water as the camera moves steadily forward. Soft afternoon sunlight, detailed realistic textures and coherent motion.

A baker wearing a brown apron rolls a small ball of dough across a flour-dusted wooden counter with both hands. The camera stays close at counter height, showing consistent fingers and gentle continuous movement in a bright kitchen.

holdout_cases.prompt: A fluffy orange cat walks across a sunlit room and gently brushes its tail against the leg of a wooden chair. A steady low camera follows the natural walking motion, with realistic fur and consistent warm light.

A woman in a blue jacket jogs at a relaxed pace along a riverside path. Her arms move naturally as the camera tracks smoothly from the side, with coherent proportions and detailed trees in soft daylight.

A close view of two hands slowly pouring clear water from a small glass pitcher into a ceramic cup on a wooden kitchen counter. The water stream and fingers remain visible throughout a continuous steady realistic shot.

A red tram moves slowly along rails past a row of old brick buildings. The camera stays steady at street level, showing smooth wheel motion and changing reflections in the windows under soft afternoon light.
